passage.label: No Indeed record wicked sijjeen; what make know sijjeen; register inscribed; Woe Day deniers; deny Day Recompense; none deny except sinful transgressor; verses recited says legends former peoples; No Rather stain covered hearts what earning; No Indeed from Lord Day partitioned; then enter burn Hellfire; then said this what used deny

arabicExcerpts.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

mainSubject.label: The record of the wicked placed in Sijjeen, an inscribed register whose gravity is questioned; woe that Day to the deniers of the Day of Recompense, denied only by every sinful transgressor who dismisses recited verses as former legends; the stain of their earnings covering their hearts, resulting in partition from their Lord that Day followed by burning in Hellfire and the declaration that this is what they used to deny

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the standing-before-the-Lord statement (6) before the Sijjeen record block opens (7); P2 ends with the this-is-what-you-denied declaration (17) before the Illiyyun record block begins (18); P3 runs through the inscribed register, couch-radiance, sealed wine and Tasneem spring (18-28); P4 covers the criminal-mockery catalogue and its eschatological reversal (29-36).
